mail.digest.intro: You have reached the limit of {{limit}} messages an hour, so the rest are collected in this one:
mail.footer: This message was sent automatically by {{product}}. Replies are not read.
mail.test.body: This is a test message. If you can read it, {{product}} can send mail with the current settings.
mail.test.subject: Test message from {{product}}
notify.admin_granted.body: You can manage users and sign-in, tool adapters, the audit log and the platform settings.
notify.admin_granted.title: You are now a platform administrator
notify.admin_revoked.body: Your roles in products stay as they are.
notify.admin_revoked.title: You are no longer a platform administrator
notify.audit_broken.body: The daily check found entry #{{seq}} changed, removed or inserted; the entries up to #{{intact}} are intact. Restore the audit log from a backup and find out who could write to the database.
notify.audit_broken.title: The audit log was tampered with
notify.feedback_accepted.body: Someone is looking into your feedback.
notify.feedback_accepted.title: FB-{{number}} was accepted
notify.feedback_commented.body: Open the feedback to read the reply.
notify.feedback_commented.title: New reply on FB-{{number}}
notify.feedback_in_progress.body: You will hear when it is resolved.
notify.feedback_in_progress.title: Work on FB-{{number}} has started
notify.feedback_reopened.body: The outcome was rated low, so the feedback is open again.
notify.feedback_reopened.title: FB-{{number}} was reopened
notify.feedback_resolved.body: If it works for you now, rate how it was handled.
notify.feedback_resolved.title: FB-{{number}} was resolved
notify.feedback_wont_fix.body: Open the feedback to read why.
notify.feedback_wont_fix.title: FB-{{number}} will not be fixed
notify.invite.body: {{inviter}} invited you to {{product}}, where your team shares Skills, MCP servers and other resources for AI tools. Open the link within {{days}} days to set a password and sign in.
notify.invite.title: You are invited to {{product}}
notify.join_approved.body: Your request to join {{product_name}} was approved. Its resources reach your computer at your next sync.
notify.join_approved.title: You can now use {{product_name}}
notify.join_rejected.body:
The reason given: {{reason}}
You can change your request and apply again.
notify.join_rejected.title: Your request to join {{product_name}} was not approved
notify.join_requested.body: Approve or reject the request under Products and members.
notify.join_requested.title: {{user}} asked to join {{product_name}}
notify.member_added.body: Its resources reach your computer at your next sync.
notify.member_added.title: You were added to {{product_name}}
notify.member_removed.body: Its resources leave your computer at your next sync.
notify.member_removed.title: You were removed from {{product_name}}
notify.owner_added.body: You can manage its members, join requests and resources.
notify.owner_added.title: You are now an owner of {{product_name}}
notify.owner_removed.body: You remain a member of it.
notify.owner_removed.title: You are no longer an owner of {{product_name}}
notify.resource_draft.body: Look at the changes and the check results, then publish it or leave it as a draft.
notify.resource_draft.title: {{resource}} has an update waiting to be published
notify.resource_new_draft.body: Look at it and the check results, then publish it or leave it as a draft.
notify.resource_new_draft.title: New resource {{resource}} is waiting to be published
notify.resource_published.body: It reaches the computers of the people it is for at their next sync.
notify.resource_published.title: {{resource}} v{{version}} is published
notify.resource_rolled_back.body: The content of v{{rollback_of}} is published again as v{{version}}. It reaches the computers of the people it is for at their next sync.
notify.resource_rolled_back.title: {{resource}} was rolled back to v{{rollback_of}}
